notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
I was finally able to recreate and identify the 3D audio issues players were having. Very sorry for the delay getting this fix out. The gameplay should be much smoother now.

[u]Gameplay and bug Fixes:[/u]

[b]Fixed 3D audio from not playing during certain attacks.

Fixed respawn rotation issues.

Added accurate mesh colliders to all areas.

Updated scene 1, phase 2 attacks to display a visual warning as well as audio.

Increased top speed and acceleration of car.

Decreased speed of enemy.

Removed all, but 1 'look to progress' actions.

Dialogue updates.[/b]

Thank you for all your feedback.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Gameplay and bug fixes.

Thank you all very much for the feedback. I'm listening to it all!

I will continue to make improvements and fix any bugs the moment I hear about or see them!

This is my first game so I appreciate everyone who played it and provided feedback to help make it even better.

Thanks
